body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/308f5c49-753c-423e-9d42-0ccc7249f401/image.png 'image.png')
tail块和tile块tiling不同，tail块继承tile块的preCoreNum，会导致UpdateBasicIndex计算params_.index时出现uint64_t负数溢出。
ops-transformer\mc2\common\op_kernel\mc2_quant_batch_matmul_asw_block.h中UpdateBasicIndex()在计算index时
params_.index = newBlockIdx + roundIdx * tilingData_->matmulTiling.usedCoreNum - preCoreNum_;
需要在tail块清零preCoreNum
### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
hw: 2P A5 
sw: master or 9.1.0 beta2
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
2P A5 
![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/47fae295-2993-48c0-b274-aa34c2b7e51c/image.png 'image.png')
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
精度正确
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/a39e9d72-3745-445c-9d50-3821701cf114/image.png 'image.png')
### Special notes for this issue/备注 (Optional / 选填)

title: [Bug-Report|缺陷反馈]: AllGatherMatmulV2 尾块preCoreNum未清零会导致某些shape的UpdateBasicIndex计算params_.index时出现uint64_t负数溢出。
